decisions.reason: The dedication content source must follow the manuscript file newly confirmed by the client as the authoritative final version.

value_updates.dedication_content_source: client-updated dedication in the edited manuscript file confirmed by the client as final

decisions.reason: Confirming the authoritative manuscript file does not change the established editing goal, approved passages, or punctuation rules.
The manuscript-source confirmation does not change illustration selection, placement, sizing, or rendering requirements.
The selected manuscript source does not alter the requested KDP upload guidance or troubleshooting workflow.
Confirming the final manuscript source does not resolve or change the existing chapter-heading formatting requirements.
The title-page arrangement was already accepted and is not changed by confirmation of the authoritative manuscript file.
The source decision does not change the copyright-page alignment, email inclusion, or planned website inclusion.
The manuscript-source decision does not alter the KDP metadata content or its separate document delivery format.
The requirement to italicize Mama's Hot Take text remains valid unchanged regardless of which manuscript file is authoritative.
The final manuscript-source confirmation does not change trim size, publication format, paragraph spacing, or page-density decisions.
Page-number and table-of-contents requirements remain necessary and unchanged after the manuscript-source confirmation.
Selecting the authoritative manuscript file does not alter the separate obligation to prepare back matter and author copy.
